units.source_text: 雨停了之后又刮起了风，他走在一个新车站的站台上。

en.t: After the rain stopped, the wind began to blow again, and he was walking along the platform of a new station.

units.source_text: 站台对面，三四名铁路工人一起抡着镐，大声唱着什么。

en.t: Across the platform, three or four railway workers were swinging pickaxes together and loudly singing something.
